example.title: How to read a notebook
example.description: Illustrative example — invented sample data, not Sakshi’s project results. This small example shows how an explanation, code and output can be read together. Code is displayed only; it does not run here.

blocks.text:
Start with a question: which sample records have a reading?

These two invented records demonstrate a simple missing-value check. They do not come from any project on this site.
blocks.provenance: Portfolio renderer example, authored for S05. Invented records; not Sakshi’s project code, dataset or results.

blocks.code:
# Illustrative only — invented sample records
records = [
    {"label": "Sample A", "reading": 12},
    {"label": "Sample B", "reading": None},
]

for record in records:
    status = "missing" if record["reading"] is None else "present"
    print(record["label"], status)
